description: This file contains helper functions for F1AP configuration, including creation of measurement timing buffers, serving cell info, system info, and setup requests for a 5G network component, utilizing ASN.1 encoding and specific 3GPP specifications.

methods.name: make_asn1_meas_time_cfg_buffer
methods.description: Creates an ASN.1 encoded measurement timing configuration buffer based on the provided cell configuration.

methods.name: make_f1ap_du_cell_info
methods.description: Generates a DU served cell info structure from cell configuration.

methods.name: make_f1ap_du_sys_info
methods.description: Creates system info for a DU based on cell configuration, optionally including a JSON string.

methods.name: fill_f1_setup_request
methods.description: Populates an F1 setup request message with parameters and cell configurations.
